releases.title: Pre-Login Update Enforcer & Offline Mode Lock
releases.patch_notes:
>> Pre-Login Update Prompt: Update check triggers strictly before login so gameplay and menus are never interrupted.
>> Main Menu Clean Up: Removed lingering update buttons from the main menu.
>> Offline-Only Protection: Players who skip an update can still access offline modes (Vs. AI, Deck Builder, Implants, Store), while online matchmaking is locked until the game is restarted and updated.

releases.title: Quantum Warhead 5x, Nexus Overhaul & 8 New Implants
releases.patch_notes:
>> Gorgon Dreadfront Lv3 Perk: Reflects 25% of damage taken directly back to attacker at any range.
>> Quantum Warhead Buff: Damage multiplied by 5x with 100% mitigation penetration and standard ship death explosion.
>> Nexus Faction 1.2x Buff: Shield capacity and direct damage multiplied by 1.2x across all 15 Nexus vessels.
>> Orbital Plasma Beam: Thermal beam now strictly damages hostile warships, bypassing Citadels and Turrets.
>> Sentry Protocol Renamed: Renamed to Overcharge Protocol with updated combat notifications.
>> Archer Balancing: Reduced hull armor slightly for tactical brawler counter-play.
>> Hyper-Focal Lens: Range implant bonus now applies unconditionally to all ships.
>> 8 New Implants: Expanded module roster to 32 implants across all 4 slots.
>> Passive Regen Nerf & Buff Icon Fix: Nerfed regenerative composite and prevented passive implants from displaying in-combat buff symbols.
>> Kamikaze Polish: Removed AoE tooltip text and scaled impact damage with kamikaze ship's max health.

releases.title: In-App Mobile Auto-Patching & Delta Patch System
releases.patch_notes:
>> In-App Mobile Patch Downloader: Updates on Android now download with an integrated progress bar directly inside the APK without opening the browser.
>> Lightweight Delta Updates: PC launcher and mobile now download only what changed (~500 KB delta patch) instead of re-downloading the entire ~200 MB game.
>> Fast Engine Patch Mounting: Runtime .pck overlay system seamlessly loads differential patches on game start on both Desktop and Mobile.
>> Windows Desktop Launcher Sync: Launcher extracts delta patch to local game directory instantly.

releases.title: Mobile UI & Tactical Touch Controls Mode
releases.patch_notes:
>> Mobile UI Mode: Complete touch-adapted interface with enlarged text, touch targets, and landscape lock.
>> Tactical Command Dock: Dedicated Confirm & Cancel controls on the left of the deck UI for safe ship requisitions, tech upgrades, and skill activations.
>> UI Mode Switcher: Added 'Interface & Control Mode' option under Settings (Auto / Desktop / Mobile) allowing players to test and toggle anytime.
>> Android APK Release: Native Android APK build published for direct mobile installation.
>> Zero Desktop Impact: Desktop PC and Web modes remain 100% untouched with instant click actions and hover tooltips.

releases.title: Store & Menu Performance Optimization (60 FPS UI)
releases.patch_notes:
>> Store & Menu Optimization: Eliminated FPS drops and stutters in Store, Main Menu, Deck Builder, and Implants Menu.
>> Cloud Sync Debouncing: Coalesced profile saves and eliminated redundant HTTP calls during 10x Supply Cache requisitions.
>> O(1) Resource & Signal Management: Removed per-frame label reshaping, mouse-input scene tree scans, and leaked signal callbacks.

releases.title: Windows Desktop Launcher & 200+ Ships 60 FPS Optimization
releases.patch_notes:
>> Official Windows Desktop Release & Auto-Updating Launcher connected to Supabase.
>> Massive 60 FPS Fleet Optimization (200+ Ships on Grid): O(N) spatial hash separation, zero-allocation target acquisition, and tiered LOD rendering.
>> Visual & Shader Culling: Automatic hull shader & aura emitter LOD above 80 active ships with zero impact on combat mechanics.
>> Weapon & VFX Pooling: Eliminated per-shot scene allocations and tree scans across cannons, missiles, and plasma beams.

releases.title: Outland Heavy Alpha & Cloaking Fixes
releases.patch_notes:
>> Outland Battlecruisers: Increased alpha strike damage (+25%) and adjusted fire rate for heavy artillery identity.
>> Stealth & Cloaking Fix: Cloaked frigates no longer reveal their position or trigger retaliatory fire while firing cloaked.
>> Online Economy Fix: Resolved Guest kill-bounty synchronization edge case in multiplayer matches.
>> Store & Checkout: Direct Stripe checkout tab launch and improved Noto Sans Symbols 2 support.
